description: Capability and conformance-target names used by adapters (hello), cases (requires) and the harness. The harness rejects any other name.

capabilities.open: open a dataset and perform the CHECK-1 checks of the manifest
capabilities.verify: check every part of an open dataset at once (CHECK-1 per part, optionally CHECK-3); optional: when claimed, each touch case also requires verify on a freshly opened dataset to return the case's expected refusal or unsupported outcome
capabilities.projection: projection of top-level non-repeated columns of the baseline physical types (COL-3)
capabilities.planning: plan a set of ranges before reading them: the rows they select, scanned once each, their count and the compressed bytes of the projected columns' pages; optional: a case that requires it is skipped when the adapter does not claim it

optional_capabilities.description: Capabilities no target requires. A case may require one besides its target's; the harness skips such a case, without counting it against qualification, when the adapter does not claim the capability.

target_dependencies.description: A target qualifies only if it has cases of its own, they pass, and every target it depends on also qualifies on the same run; claiming a target runs the cases of its dependencies too.
